description: The shipped de pack corrects a deducted input tax on its own accounts and under its own reporting key. Every number in this fixture comes from the pack and none from the engine: five years for a movable asset and ten for an immovable one, the 1,000.00 threshold below which nothing is observed at all, the ten-percentage-point-or-1,000.00 test on the change, accounts 1500 / 6000 / 4900, and Kennzahl 63. The engine contributes the mechanism — a pro-rata correction over an observation period with two de-minimis thresholds — which is the same wherever such a rule exists, and it is why the `us` pack simply declares no such module and the operation says so instead of inventing a period. What the shipped pack also demonstrates is the boundary this rule is cut along: the REGISTER of which assets are under observation, and until when, is not here and not in the library, because the trigger is a change of use and a change of use is never posted. The arithmetic is here, because a figure produced wrongly would look exactly as authoritative as one produced rightly.

expect.comment: Fünf Jahre laut Pack: 19.000,00 × −40 % ÷ 5 = −1.520,00, gebucht auf 6000 gegen 1500
Dasselbe bei einem Grundstück: zehn Jahre, also die halbe Jahresberichtigung
Unter Kennzahl 63 des Packs, und ohne Lückenwarnung — ohne den Meldeschlüssel trüge die Buchung nichts zur Voranmeldung bei
